fichas.title: Vehicle traffic space at full speed
fichas.summary: Diagrams give traffic-space and clearance dimensions for vehicle encounters at full speed (≥50 km/h). Vehicle traffic space combines the assessment vehicle, movement margins, allowance for two-directional traffic, and space above the drainage channel and hard shoulder. The accompanying text specifies vehicle, bicycle, pedestrian, and side-safety clearances.
uses: Providing space for bicycle and pedestrian traffic

fichas.summary: Diagrams show the traffic-space widths for truck, van, bus, and car encounters with full-speed reduced conditions, headed for reduced speeds of ≤40 km/h. The printed overall widths are recorded by encounter type.

fichas.title: Dimensions of clear space and traffic space for vehicles
fichas.summary: A section diagram defines the spatial components used for vehicle traffic and adjacent cycle and pedestrian spaces. It labels clearances for side and head room, pedestrians, cyclists, and motor vehicles, and identifies roadway, cycle path, kerb, walking space, and pavement.
